title: Enterprise AI Voice Contact Center Architecture Selection Guide: Azure OpenAI Realtime API (GPT-4o-Audio) vs. Self-Hosted WebRTC + Fast-ASR + SGLang + Streaming TTS

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Legacy HTTP REST Turn-by-Turn (Wait for Full LLM Completion Before TTS Synthesis)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Unusable for natural phone conversations due to 2.85s awkward silence gaps

tiers.tier: Tier 2: 100% Commercial Native Speech-to-Speech API (GPT-4o-Realtime Audio)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Ideal for low-volume VIP emotional concierge, prohibitive ($2.2M/mo) at 10M minutes/month

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Streaming WebRTC (LiveKit/Pipecat) + Semantic VAD + Fast-ASR + SGLang (6-Word Chunk) + Streaming TTS
tiers.recommended_scenario: High-volume regulated banking/telecom contact center standard with 100% pre-TTS text compliance

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Hybrid 90% Streaming WebRTC Pipeline + 10% Thinker-Talker Native S2S Escalation
tiers.recommended_scenario: Flagship contact center architecture hitting 410ms M2E and saving $1.82M/month (-82.7%) vs. Tier 2
